items.summary: Starlink enables fast, reliable connectivity where traditional infrastructure does not exist 🛰️🏔️ OffRoadCampingBoys (@OffRoadCampBoys) Many of the areas we went, there is not a single cell provider that has reception for long distances. Here is a speed test location at one camp site. And, yes, the more remote the better it performs. We ran Starlink for 8,431 miles - non-stop and turned off cellular data to prevent switching and dropping from the network. — https://nitter.net/OffRoadCampBoys/status/2079023053942751663#m
